title: Wetlands
body: The Wetlands are a vast, cold marsh between the mountains of Khaz Modan and the sea, cloaked in mist beneath a sky that rarely clears. This was dwarven country once, overlooked by Grim Batol, but war after war has left most of its holds in rubble. The Alliance clings to the coast at Menethil Harbor. Inland, the Dark Irons have broken the Thandol Span and taken Dun Modr, the Dragonmaw have crept back out of the eastern hills, and red dragons guard the sealed gates of Grim Batol.

title: Menethil Harbor
body: Menethil Harbor sits on the western shore of the Wetlands, the Alliance's only stronghold in the region. Orgrim Doomhammer first chose these waters to build the Horde's invasion fleet; after the Second War the site was rebuilt as an Alliance port under Admiral Daelin Proudmoore and named for King Terenas Menethil II. Ships sail from its docks across the sea to Theramore.

parts.body: Since the Alliance took its war to the Lich King, the Northspear sails from here for Valgarde in the Howling Fjord, carrying soldiers north to the new front.

title: The Lost Fleet
body: Off the northern coast lie the wrecks of the Kul Tiras Third Fleet, sunk in the Second War when red dragons ridden by Dragonmaw orcs fell upon it with fire. Its drowned sailors still walk the rotting decks, bound there, says the fleet's one survivor, by something terrible locked aboard the Intrepid.

parts.body: The Intrepid's strongbox held a blackened orb pulsing with eerie light, a Cursed Eye of Paleth: one of the Eyes made by human priests, tainted by the tragedy it had witnessed.

title: Dun Modr
body: Dun Modr is an old dwarven town just south of the Thandol Span, long the key to the whole region. While Ironforge's soldiers fought for the Alliance in distant lands, the Dark Iron dwarves struck at home: they broke the Span and fell upon the town before its regiment could regroup. Longbraid the Grim and his survivors hold a camp outside the walls, waiting on reserves that never seem to come.

title: Thandol Span
body: The Thandol Span was raised by the dwarves of Ironforge after the War of the Three Hammers, two arches joining Khaz Modan to the lands of Lordaeron so that kinship with the Wildhammers of Aerie Peak might endure. When the Dark Irons struck, an explosion tore the west bridge apart, and the remaining arch is now the dwarves' only road north.

parts.body: The Dark Irons were not finished. A cache of explosives hidden across the bridge, ready to bring down the last arch, was found and destroyed in time.

title: Whelgar's Excavation Site
body: East of Menethil Harbor, the Explorers' League dug into the marsh under Prospector Whelgar until mottled raptors overran the site. Before the beasts came, the dig turned up great bones and the Goaz Stone, an ancient tablet whose broken text spoke of a divine plan and a doomed prophecy.

parts.body: Made whole again, the Goaz Stone gave up its first new words in Titan script: Old Gods, chained beneath the land.

title: Grim Batol
body: In the eastern mountains stands Grim Batol, where Thane Khardros founded the kingdom of the Wildhammer clan. Cursed in the dwarves' civil war and abandoned by its builders, it became the stronghold of the Dragonmaw in the Second War, until the dragons held captive there broke free and tore it apart. Now its gates are sealed, and red dragonkin guard them against all comers.
